description: COMP 311 Lab 5 — RV32I single-cycle subset (Harris&Harris-style control).

alu.dig.role: ALU: applies the operation selected by ALUOp (AND, OR, ADD, XOR, SLL, SRL, SUB, SLT, SRA) to A and B, shifting A by B[4:0], and raises FlagZ when the result is zero.

control-unit.dig.role: Control unit: decodes opcode/funct3/funct7 into the datapath's control signals for the eight Lab 5 instructions.

register-file.dig.role: Register file: 32 registers read on two ports; writes WriteData into WriteReg on the clock edge when RegWrite is 1 (x0 stays 0).

add-sub.dig.role: Adder/subtractor: A plus or minus B with signed-overflow and sign flags.

bidirectional-shifter.dig.role: Shifter: shifts A left, right logical or right arithmetic by B[4:0], chosen by ShiftOp.

boolean-unit.dig.role: Boolean unit: bitwise AND, OR, XOR or NOR of A and B, chosen by Bool.

slt-unit.dig.role: Set-less-than unit: derives A<B from the subtractor's sign and overflow flags.

subcircuits._note: Layer 3 Mode A treats a passing subcircuit as its formula model instead of simulating it; 'model': 'simulate' forces gate-level simulation. 'role' is the one-line description Layer 2 shows for the subcircuit.

_note: reference_dir stays null in the repo; instructors point DLC_REFERENCE_DIR at their local solutions folder.

program_decode.note: bit ranges [low_bit, width] of a 32-bit RV32I word; field names match the control-unit category predicate columns

observe._note: testcase columns showing the register-file read ports; lets the proposer auto-append machine-derived read-back rows (addi x0, xN, 0) for any register an extension writes but never reads
